annotation.interpretation_a: IANA is required to add the registry if it does not already exist.
annotation.interpretation_b: IANA has already added the registry, and this clause is simply stating a fact.
annotation.justification: The phrase "SHALL add/has added" is ambiguous. It is unclear whether IANA is *required* to add the registry, or whether the registry *has been* added. This affects implementation because a reader might incorrectly assume the registry exists when it does not, or vice versa.
